messages:
Maya: Quick sync — post-launch backlog split. Need to decide which of the customer-reported items are immediate bugs vs enhancements for the next 2 sprints. Short callout: embed regressions from CustA, streaming latency from CustB, and a UX tweak from multiple customers.

Alex: Can you paste the list + IDs?

Maya: pasted below (from support triage):
```
RD-7012 — embed output missing for long docs (CustA)
RD-7017 — streaming stalls intermittently (CustB)
RD-7022 — ranking differs vs prod baseline (internal)
RD-7030 — prompt UI: line-wrap overflow in mobile (multiple customers)
RD-7041 — reduce cold-start for dedicated pools (infra/ops)
RD-7048 — doc-level metadata not included in embeddings (CustC)
```

Chris: My read — RD-7012 and RD-7017 feel like regressions -> bug lane (P0/P1). RD-7022 is likely model drift/quality, treat as enhancement with evals. RD-7030 UX is small but high NPS impact -> enhancement but fast follow-on. RD-7048 maybe bug depending on root cause.

Jordan: +1. For RD-7012 we saw correlated KV cache misses in logs. Recommend hotfix can land in sprint 1 if Alex can take.

Alex: I can pick up RD-7012 hotfix, but need 2 dev-days and a quick QA run. If we push RD-7012 to sprint 1, we should deprioritize one non-critical enhancement. :thumbsup:

Sam: Ops note — RD-7041 (cold-start) requires infra changes and billing impact analysis. Not realistic for sprint 1. Recommend scheduled work in sprint 3 unless we get exec priority.

Maya: Proposal:
- Sprint 1 (2 weeks): ship hotfix for RD-7012 (owner: Alex), triage RD-7017 for repro/trace (owner: Jordan), quick UX fix RD-7030 as a patch if it doesn't block mobile builds.
- Sprint 2: tackle RD-7022 eval + model rollout plan (Chris), and RD-7048 investigation + fix if root cause is ingestion bug.
- RD-7041 flagged for roadmap planning (sprint 3+).

Chris: Acceptance criteria for RD-7012 hotfix: reproducer added to test harness, unit/regression test, rolling canary with 10% traffic for 24h, monitoring alert for increased embed drop rate.

Alex: Sounds good. I'll open the PR and link the test. ETA end of day tomorrow.

Jordan: I'll attach relevant trace snippets to RD-7017 and try to repro with the customer corpus.

Maya: Thanks — last ask: PMs, let's create a short customer note for CustA and CustB acknowledging we're on it and expected timelines (ETA Sprint 1 hotfix for CustA, investigation update for CustB in 3 business days).

ProdBot: Ticket RD-7234 created: "post-launch backlog split — sprint assignments" by Maya.

Alex: @Maya will update tickets and add the canary rollout plan. :eyes:

Maya: Perfect — will follow up in the weekly triage.

Chris: +1
